welcome.title: Welcome to {{app}}
welcome.body: {{app}} is a self-hostable AI assistant: chat privately or in groups, with long-term memory that stays with you — and your data stays on your own server. This short tour walks you through the essentials.

chat.title: Personal & group conversations
chat.body: Chat quietly with a single AI, or pull several AIs into one group conversation and watch them answer together. Send a document and the AI understands it right away; turn on Infinite Mode and the AI keeps reasoning on its own.

memory.title: AI memory
memory.body: AIs keep what matters about you in long-term memory and recall it naturally in later conversations. From the memory panel in the sidebar, you can view, edit, or delete each AI's memories at any time.

im.title: Continue on IM
im.body: Bind WeChat or QQ and take any conversation with you — continue it in your IM anytime, anywhere, right from your phone.

finale.title: You're all set
finale.body: Click the app name at the top of the sidebar to revisit this guide anytime. Now, start your first conversation.
